'''Cessed''' was the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] closest to the [[Csilla (star)|sun]] in the [[Csilla system/Legends|Csilla system]],<ref name="TEA" /> which was located within [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Space]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was uninhabited due to the searing hot temperatures emanating from the sun.<ref name="TEA" />
